notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed these bugs:
[list][*]Distractible objects thrown outside could cause dog to walk into walls
[*]Sometimes couldn't interact/go through with window after destroying
[*]Tutorial prompts could overlay and show on top of each other sometimes
[*]When pickup golden key before finish falling off parent, would stay bright color + would allow to pickup anywhere
[*]Another bug when picking up objects and finding them in searchable objects
[*]Fixed a couple bugs in the demo version too[/list]
Also Sneak Out is available on Mac now :)
